title: Risotto con Salsiccia
subtitle: Italian sausage and fennel risotto
excerpt: Italian sausage meat and fennel seeds make a hearty, warming risotto that feels more like a meal than a first course. The sausage crumbles into the rice and flavours the whole dish. A glass of white wine while you stir is recommended.
sourceNotes: Risotto with sausage is a northern Italian winter staple, particularly in Lombardy and Piedmont. Italian pork sausages are typically seasoned with fennel, garlic and white wine.

content.text: If using sausages, squeeze the meat from the casings and break it up in the pan. Let it brown properly before adding the onion -- this gives the sausage a slightly crisp texture in the finished dish.

items.prepNote: use 300g Italian pork sausages, squeezed from casings

content.text: Heat the olive oil in a wide, heavy pan over medium-high heat. Add the sausage meat. Break it up and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until browned and a little crisp. Remove and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium-low. Add the onion and fennel seeds. Cook in the sausage fat for 8 minutes until the onion is soft. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes to toast. Pour in the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring after each. Continue for about 18 minutes.
When the rice is almost done, stir the browned sausage back in. Cook for 2 more minutes until everything is hot and the rice is just tender.
Remove from the heat. Beat in the cold butter and Parmesan. Rest for 2 minutes. Serve in deep warm bowls with extra Parmesan and black pepper.

items.symptom: Sausage is greasy throughout the risotto
items.cause: Too much fat left in the pan from browning
items.fix: Drain most of the excess fat from the pan after browning the sausage. Keep just enough to cook the onion.

items.cause: Too many seeds or not crushed before using
items.fix: Use half a teaspoon next time. Crushing the seeds lightly releases some oil but keeps the flavour from being too sharp.

content.text: Sausage risotto is a northern Italian winter staple. It is found across Lombardy and Piedmont. It is rich, warming food that suits a cold evening. A simple green salad is the only thing it needs alongside.
